notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes: [h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New music has been implemented[/p][/*][*][p]The player now has a death animation in which he explodes and the screen has a pull effect[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades can be purchased upon death without returning to the menu[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483520/85610991b6aa68ff6fcc951ff559501f91ea23ce.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]HORDES OF ENEMIES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjustment in the number of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment in the number of descents per wave[/p][/*][*][p]Inclusion of random events[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemy animations have been changed[/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483520/88a9a8c2dbfcfc038db901d01ccd050591c5b018.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]NEW LOOK[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Change in the look of the cover and menus in general[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483520/852363439e63c56a283d77f586a819ee6ac30616.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
